entries.reason: Schema selection folds into the source's tables list only when a literal table.include.list is also set; alone it cannot be expressed.
entries.fix: List the tables explicitly in table.include.list (schema.table), or keep this connector on Kafka Connect.

notes.reason: Debezium-compatible output mode is not available. The released builtin:postgres source has no debezium.enabled setting and the debezium.encode processor has not landed, so the pipeline emits OpenCDC-shaped records, not the Debezium envelope (before/after structs, source, op, ts_ms) or its topic naming. Consumers of the Debezium envelope break.
notes.fix: Keep this connector on Kafka Connect until the Debezium output mode ships (#3032), or accept the difference with --accept-gaps.

notes.reason: The builtin:kafka destination requires servers, and no key of the Kafka Connect config sets it; the pipeline references ${KC_INVENTORY_CONNECTOR_DESTINATION_SERVERS} instead.
notes.fix: Set KC_INVENTORY_CONNECTOR_DESTINATION_SERVERS in the environment (see secrets.env.template), or pass the worker file with --worker if it holds bootstrap.servers.

notes.reason: Neither the connector nor a worker file sets key.converter, so the format Kafka Connect used is unknown.
notes.fix: Pass the worker properties with --worker, or set key.converter on the connector, then re-run.

notes.reason: Neither the connector nor a worker file sets value.converter, so the format Kafka Connect used is unknown.
notes.fix: Pass the worker properties with --worker, or set value.converter on the connector, then re-run.

notes.reason: The input holds at least one secret as a literal value. migrate wrote a variable reference instead, but the input file itself contains the secret.
notes.fix: Fill the variables in secrets.env.template from your secret store, and replace the literal in the Kafka Connect config with a config-provider reference.

notes.reason: plugin.name is absent, so Debezium uses decoderbufs; Conduit decodes with pgoutput only, and decoder-specific differences are not emulated.
notes.fix: Set plugin.name=pgoutput in the Kafka Connect config, or accept the difference.

notes.reason: table.include.list is absent, so Debezium reads every table; the source is set to tables "*", whose schema coverage is connector-defined.
notes.fix: Set table.include.list to the tables to read, or accept the difference.

notes.reason: Kafka Connect does not retry a failed operation by default (errors.retry.timeout=0). Conduit restarts a failed pipeline through pipeline recovery, so a transient failure that stopped the connector may not stop the pipeline.
Kafka Connect's default header converter types header values; Conduit carries headers as metadata strings.
